resources.string: Lets the Open Android Use agent see the screen and perform UI actions on your behalf. The control endpoint listens on this device only (127.0.0.1) and is reachable from a computer solely through USB debugging. Disable this service at any time to cut the agent off.

On Android 13+, if you sideloaded this app you may see a “Restricted setting” notice when enabling accessibility. To allow it: open Settings > Apps > Open Android Use Companion, tap the ⋮ menu (top-right), choose “Allow restricted settings,” then return and enable the service. (This step goes away when the app is installed from the Play Store.)
A second pair of hands for your Android device.

The agent runs here. Its control endpoint binds to this device only (127.0.0.1) and is reachable from a computer solely via USB debugging.
Only your task and the on-screen context (a text view of the screen and screenshots) — sent to the model provider you choose (api.anthropic.com) to decide the next action. Nothing else is uploaded.
Stored encrypted in the Android Keystore with a non-exportable key; the plaintext never touches disk and leaves the device only toward the provider.
Conversations are saved on this device as text so you can revisit and resume them. Screenshots are never written to disk. Delete any conversation, or all of them, below or from History.

Permanently deletes every saved conversation on this device. This can\'t be undone.

Open Android Use is an AI agent that operates this phone for you — it sees the screen and taps, types, and scrolls on your behalf. Everything runs on this device; you stay in control and can stop it at any time.
This quick setup takes about a minute.
The agent works through Android\'s accessibility service — that\'s how it sees the screen and performs taps and gestures. Turn it on for \"Open Android Use Companion\".
The agent runs here. The control endpoint binds to this device only (127.0.0.1).
Only your task and screen context, sent to the model provider you choose (api.anthropic.com) to decide the next action.
Stored encrypted in the Android Keystore — it never leaves the device except to the provider.
Paste an Anthropic API key to let the agent run. You can skip this and add it later — you\'ll be prompted when you start a task.
You can change these any time in Agent Chat → Settings.
Accessibility: off — enable it to let the agent act
API key: not set — add it when you start a task
